# palette-slash

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-001 — The palette mode decides the button sets, in registry order](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-001.md) — When the extension builds the edition palette of a block editor, the extension SHALL start it with a select named Palette buttons that offers Strict Markdown, GitHub (GFM), MyST and Full and shows the current mode, and list below it the buttons of that mode in the order of the registry, marking the start of each group.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-002 — Every edit bar button shows the slide-in tooltip and the rule button a dashes icon](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-002.md) — While a block editor is open, the extension SHALL give every button of its edit bar the data-tooltip attribute with the text of its title, so that hovering or focusing the button shows the same sliding tooltip bubble as the floating toolbar, and SHALL draw the Horizontal rule button as three dashes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-003 — The Table of contents action inserts a \[TOC\] marker](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-003.md) — When the user runs the Table of contents action from the edition palette or the /toc entry of the slash menu in a block editor, the editor SHALL insert a \[TOC\] line set apart by blank lines after the line the selection ends on and place the caret after it, in every palette mode.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-010 — An unknown palette mode is refused and stores nothing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-010.md) — When the page posts previewPaletteModeChanged with a mode other than strict, gfm, myst or full, the extension SHALL refuse the message and keep the stored mode unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-017 — Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+M reaches the mode select and Escape or Enter returns to the text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-017.md) — When the writer presses Cmd+Shift+M on macOS or Ctrl+Shift+M elsewhere in the block text box, the extension SHALL close any open picker and move the focus to the mode select, whose tooltip names that key, and give the focus back to the text box without changing the mode when the writer presses Escape or Enter, or clicks a second time, on the select.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-021 — The palette is a toolbar above the editor that sticks over a tall editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-021.md) — When a block editor opens, the extension SHALL place the edition palette as a toolbar named Edition palette on top of the editor frame, outside the frame, inside one host element that holds both, from the arrival of the source of the block until the editor closes, and keep it in reach, sticking or wrapping, while a tall editor scrolls or the pane is narrow, without covering the first lines of an editor that fits in the viewport when it opens or the panels in it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-031 — Palette popovers open in the frame, one at a time, and Escape or typing closes them](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-031.md) — When the writer opens, leaves or dismisses a popover of the palette, the extension SHALL open it inside the editor frame under its button (under the caret for the alert list), keep at most one open, and close it on Escape or on typing or pressing in the text box, giving the focus back to the text box and keeping the editor open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-036 — Leaving the frame from a palette control saves once and a press keeps the text box focus](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-036.md) — When the writer presses the mouse on a palette control or the focus leaves one, the extension SHALL cancel a press that is not on a text field so that the text box keeps the focus, and run the normal final save once only when the focus goes outside the editor frame.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-039 — A palette action edits in one undo step or leaves the text unchanged and says why](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-039.md) — When a palette button, a slash command or a shortcut runs an action, the extension SHALL apply the edit that the action returns to the text box as one native editing step that autosaves the editor and leaves the selection that the action returned, and, when the action returns no edit, leave the text unchanged, put the focus back in the text box and show the reason in the status line when the action has one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-043 — The Heading list sets the heading level of the touched lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-043.md) — When the writer presses the Heading button, the extension SHALL open a menu named Heading with the entries Paragraph and Heading 1 to Heading 5, and apply the chosen level by putting the matching number of # signs and a space in front of every non-blank line that the selection touches, replacing another level, and removing the prefix for Paragraph.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-045 — Bold and Italic toggle their shared asterisk markers](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-045.md) — When the writer presses Bold or Italic, the extension SHALL wrap the selection, ignoring the blanks at its edges, or the word at a collapsed caret, in two or one asterisks, insert an empty pair at a caret outside a word, remove the markers when they are already there, add or remove only its own share of a run of asterisks, and produce no edit when the selection cuts into a run of asterisks on one side only.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-048 — Strikethrough toggles a double tilde pair](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-048.md) — When the writer presses Strikethrough, the extension SHALL wrap the selection, or the word at a collapsed caret, in ~~ markers, insert an empty pair at a caret outside a word, and remove the markers when they are already there.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-049 — Blockquote prefixes the touched lines or removes one quote level](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-049.md) — When the writer presses Blockquote, the extension SHALL put > and a space in front of every touched line, before a list marker, or remove one quote level when every non-blank touched line is already quoted.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-050 — Horizontal rule puts three dashes between blank lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-050.md) — When the writer presses Horizontal rule, the extension SHALL insert --- on its own line, set apart by blank lines, after the line the selection ends on, with the caret after it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-052 — Bulleted list toggles a dash prefix, from the slash menu only](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-052.md) — When the writer runs Bulleted list, the extension SHALL put - and a space in front of every touched non-blank line, replacing a numbered marker, and remove the markers when every non-blank touched line already has one, and offer it only as a slash menu entry in every mode and block scope, without a palette button and without a shortcut.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-053 — Numbered list numbers the touched non-blank lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-053.md) — When the writer runs Numbered list, the extension SHALL put 1. , 2. and so on in front of the touched non-blank lines, replacing a bullet marker, and remove the markers when every non-blank touched line already has one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-054 — The Code block list wraps lines in a fence of a highlighted language](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-054.md) — When the writer presses Code block, the extension SHALL open a menu that lists text first and then each language name and alias that the preview highlights, once and in sorted order, and wrap the touched lines, or an empty fence at the caret, in a fence that names the chosen language, is one backtick longer than the longest backtick run in the code and at least three long, and names no language when none or an invalid name is given.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-058 — The Colour picker wraps the selection in a safe colour span](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-058.md) — When the writer presses Colour, the extension SHALL open a picker with the tabs Text and Background, sixteen colour swatches, a field for a colour code and a Remove button, apply a swatch, a valid colour code or Remove to the property of the open tab as a span whose only attribute is a colour style, and produce no edit for a value the sanitizer would strip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-069 — The Colour code button edits a colour code at the caret](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-069.md) — When the caret or selection lies inside a #rgb, #rrggbb or rgb() colour code that is not part of a word or a character reference, the extension SHALL show the Colour code button with a swatch of that colour, hide it otherwise, and let its picker, started on the colour of the code with no tabs and no Remove button, replace the code under the caret in place and close when the caret leaves the code.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-072 — The Emoji picker filters and inserts one pictograph](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-072.md) — When the writer presses Emoji, the extension SHALL open a picker with a field named Filter emoji and about 150 emoji in six named categories, none of them a flag, each button with its English name as title and accessible name, show only the emoji whose English name contains every typed word, case-insensitively, and insert a chosen emoji at the caret, replacing a selection, only when it is one run of at most 16 UTF-16 code units made of pictographs, joiners and variation selectors.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-078 — The Table button opens a 9 by 9 size grid and inserts a table of the chosen size](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-078.md) — When the writer presses Table, the extension SHALL open a popover with a 9 by 9 grid of 81 cells, each named by its row and column, and a label that reads Table size until a cell is lit, and insert the table of the size the writer chooses by pointer or by keyboard as one undoable step, returning the focus to the text box.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-083 — Cmd or Ctrl with B, I or K runs Bold, Italic or Link on the platform's command key](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-083.md) — When the writer presses Cmd+B, Cmd+I or Cmd+K on macOS, or Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I or Ctrl+K elsewhere, in the block text box, the extension SHALL run Bold, Italic or the Link panel, matching the typed letter before the physical key, matching no other key press, and naming the shortcut in the tooltip of each palette button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-086 — Cmd or Ctrl with the slash key matches the TODO shortcut on every platform](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-086.md) — When the writer presses Cmd+/ or Ctrl+/, with or without Shift, in a block text box, the extension SHALL match the shortcut of the TODO action.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-089 — The Link button opens a labelled link panel prefilled from the selection](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-089.md) — When the writer presses the Link button or Cmd+K or Ctrl+K, the extension SHALL open the link panel under the palette, a dialog named Insert link with the fields Text and URL and the buttons Insert and Cancel, prefilled from the selection, and make no edit until the panel is submitted.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-092 — The link panel writes a safe inline Markdown link](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-092.md) — When the writer presses Enter in the Text or URL field of the link panel or presses Insert, the extension SHALL write \[text\](url) over the selection, or over the link around the caret, as one undoable step with the text and the target escaped so that they cannot break the link, and return the focus to the text box.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-109 — The Image button inserts or replaces an image reference](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-109.md) — When the writer presses Image, the extension SHALL ask the host for a native image file dialog, keep the editor open while the dialog is shown, and insert or replace an image reference only when a valid path comes back.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-114 — Thread inserts an empty comment thread after the block with the author and the date](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-114.md) — When the writer presses Thread, the extension SHALL insert after the block at the caret a comment made of the line `<!-- THREAD`, a line with the author and the local date and time, an indented empty line and the line `-->`, with the caret on the empty line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-115 — Alert inserts a GitHub alert and offers its type list](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-115.md) — When the writer presses Alert, the extension SHALL quote the touched lines under the head `> \[!NOTE\]`, or leave the text alone when the caret is already in an alert, and open at the caret a list of Note, Tip, Important, Warning and Caution with none lit, from which a chosen type replaces the type word of the head of the alert at the caret.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-123 — Checkbox toggles a task list box on the touched lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-123.md) — When the writer presses Checkbox, the extension SHALL add \[ \] after the list marker of the touched lines, or - \[ \] to lines that have no marker, and remove the box from every line when all of them have one, keeping the list item.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-124 — Collapsible wraps the touched lines in a details element with a summary](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-124.md) — When the writer presses Collapsible, the extension SHALL wrap the touched lines, or a sample content, in a details element with a summary, select the summary text and leave a blank line after the summary.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-125 — Footnote adds a numbered reference and an empty definition at the end](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-125.md) — When the writer presses Footnote, the extension SHALL add `\[^n\]` after the selection and an empty definition `\[^n\]:` at the end of the text, after the definitions already there, with the caret in it, where n is one more than the highest numeric label in use.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-126 — Key wraps the selection in kbd tags, removes them, or inserts a sample](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-126.md) — When the writer presses Key, the extension SHALL wrap the selection in a kbd element, remove the tags when the selection or its surroundings already have them, and insert a kbd element with the sample Key selected when nothing is selected.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-127 — Admonition wraps lines in a colon fence of a chosen type](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-127.md) — When the writer presses Admonition and chooses a type from the menu of Note, Tip, Important, Warning, Caution, Danger, Attention, Error, Hint, See also and Custom…, the extension SHALL wrap the touched lines in a colon fence `:::{type}`, or with no selection insert an empty fence set apart by blank lines with the caret on the empty body line, and make no edit for a missing or unknown type.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-130 — Custom writes a titled admonition with a class](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-130.md) — When the writer chooses Custom in the Admonition menu, the extension SHALL write `:::{admonition} Title` with the option `:class: note`, and select the word Title.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-132 — Definition list makes the selection a term with a definition](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-132.md) — When the writer presses Definition list, the extension SHALL add a line `: Definition` below the touched lines and select Definition, or insert a sample term and definition after the text when nothing is selected.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-133 — Math wraps the selection in an inline, display or aligned equation](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-133.md) — When the writer presses Math and chooses a kind of the menu of `Inline $…$`, `Display $$` and Aligned equations, the extension SHALL write the selection, or a sample, as `$text$`, as a `$$` block or as a `$$` block with a begin and end align environment, and refuse any other kind.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-135 — Subscript and Superscript wrap the selection in a role](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-135.md) — When the writer presses Subscript or Superscript, the extension SHALL wrap the selection in the sub or sup role, put the caret between the quotes when nothing is selected, and make no edit for a selection that contains a backtick or a line break.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-136 — Label writes one label line above the block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-136.md) — When the writer presses Label, the extension SHALL write the line `(label-name)=` above the first line of the text with label-name selected, and make no edit when the text already starts with a label line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-137 — Dropdown writes a note admonition with the dropdown class](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-137.md) — When the writer presses Dropdown, the extension SHALL write a note admonition with the title Title and the option `:class: dropdown` around the touched lines, or around the sample Content, with Title selected.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-138 — Key (MyST) wraps the selection in the kbd role](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-138.md) — When the writer presses Key (MyST), the extension SHALL wrap the selection in the kbd role, or insert the role with the sample Ctrl+K selected when nothing is selected, and make no edit for a selection that contains a backtick.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-140 — Reference and Citation open a filterable list filled by the host](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-140.md) — When the writer presses Reference or Citation, the extension SHALL open a popover with a filter field, show Loading... until the host answers, and then list one button per entry with its detail text, narrowed by the words typed in the filter.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-147 — A chosen label is written as a ref role](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-147.md) — When the writer chooses a label, the extension SHALL write {ref} with the label in backticks in place of the selection, using the one-line selection as the link text when there is one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-148 — Document link picks a Markdown file and writes a doc role](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-148.md) — When the writer presses Document link, the extension SHALL ask the host through previewPickDocument for a native file dialog on md and markdown files, keep the editor open while it is shown, and write {doc} with the picked path, relative to the document and without its extension, in place of the selection, or nothing when the dialog is cancelled.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-149 — A chosen bibliography key is written as a cite role](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-149.md) — When the writer chooses a key in the Citation list, the extension SHALL write {cite} with the key in backticks in place of the selection, and produce no edit for a key that is empty or that holds a blank, a comma, a backtick, an angle bracket or a line break.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-150 — Figure writes a figure directive for a picked image](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-150.md) — When the host answers a path for the Figure button outside a figure, the extension SHALL write a figure directive with that path, the option :alt: set to the file name without extension and the touched lines, or an empty line, as the caption.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-153 — The figure form edits the options of a figure and checks them](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-153.md) — When the writer opens the figure form, from the Edit figure button over a hovered figure in edit mode or from Figure with the caret in a figure, the extension SHALL show a dialog with the fields Source, Alt text, Caption, Legend, Width, Align and Name, check them when the form is applied, and show each problem under its field while the form stays open and unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-160 — Apply rewrites the figure directive in one minimal edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-160.md) — When the writer applies the figure form with a change, the extension SHALL replace the directive with the rewritten one in one edit that keeps every untouched part byte for byte, and keep the editor open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-174 — The host drops a request that does not name the render it holds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-174.md) — When a list, pick or paste message reaches the host, the extension SHALL handle it only when it names the document, the revision and the request of the render that the host holds.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-178 — The host lists the label targets of the document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-178.md) — When the host answers previewListTargets, the extension SHALL list the lines (name)= of the current document text that are outside code fences and whose name starts with a letter or digit and holds only letters, digits, underscore, dot, colon and hyphen, in source order, each with the heading or first text line after it as detail clipped to 80 characters, at most 500 entries, and set the truncated flag when the list is cut.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-183 — The host scans nearby bibliography files for citation keys within bounds](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-183.md) — When the host answers previewListCitations, the extension SHALL search the .bib files of the folder of the document first and then of its workspace folder outside the folders node_modules, .git, _build, .venv, venv, out and dist, read at most 20 files within 2 MiB and 5 seconds, and answer the unique entry keys sorted, at most 1000, each with its title, marking the list truncated when any bound cuts it, or answer ok false with the message of the error when the scan fails.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-192 — The host image picker answers a path relative to the document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-192.md) — When previewPickImage reaches the host for a trusted, saved document, the extension SHALL open a native dialog in the folder of the document filtered to png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp and svg with the label Insert image, answer the picked file as a path relative to the document with forward slashes and blanks kept, or cancelled, or refuse a file that is outside every workspace folder, is not a local image or cannot be written in a reference with a reason the page shows, and read or write nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-196 — The host saves a pasted image next to the document under a name it chooses](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-196.md) — When previewPasteImage is accepted, the extension SHALL check the request and the image bytes, save the image in the folder of the document as image.png, image.jpg, image.gif or image.webp, or with the suffix -1, -2 and so on up to -1000 when the name is taken, comparing names without case, never showing the name before all its bytes are written, remove first the hidden partial files of its own naming that are older than 10 minutes, and answer the file name, or write nothing and answer a refusal with its reason when a check or the write fails.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-203 — A pasted image is sent to the host and its name inserted on its own paragraph](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-203.md) — When the writer pastes into the block text box a clipboard that holds no text and a png, jpeg, gif or webp file of at most 10 MB, the extension SHALL take over the paste, remember the selection, read the first such file as base64, send it to the host with its type, and when the host answers a file name replace the remembered selection with !\[name\](name) as a paragraph of its own, showing any refusal or read failure in the status line and inserting nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-213 — Pasted rich text is converted by the host and replaces the selection in one step](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-213.md) — When the writer pastes into the block text box a clipboard that holds text/html of 1 to 1,000,000 characters and the paste is not a paste as plain text, the extension SHALL take over the paste, send the HTML to the host for conversion, and replace the selection of the moment of the paste with the Markdown answer in one undo step and autosave it, or with the plain text of the clipboard when the conversion fails or is empty, only if that editor is still open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-217 — Pasted HTML becomes the matching Markdown](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-217.md) — When the clipboard HTML of a paste is converted, the extension SHALL write the Markdown of each element it knows (headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, images, lists, code, block quotes and tables), escape text that Markdown would read as markup, keep only the text of every other element, and give an empty text when nothing readable is left.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-229 — Pasted HTML never brings active content](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-229.md) — When the clipboard HTML of a paste is converted, the extension SHALL drop script, style, embedded, form control, media and template elements, comments and hidden content, read only a short list of attributes, and keep only the text of a link or image whose address is not safe.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-232 — A slash opens the slash menu only where a command is meant](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-232.md) — When the writer types a slash with no selection at the start of a line or after whitespace in the text box of a paragraph editor, an insertion editor, a Start writing editor or a table cell editor, outside inline code and fenced code and not by a paste or an IME composition, the extension SHALL open the slash menu, and close it when a composition starts or when the typed command holds a space or a second slash, leaving the text as typed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-238 — The slash menu lists the palette commands of the mode and scope](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-238.md) — When the slash menu opens, the extension SHALL list the actions of the palette for the current mode and scope in the order of the buttons, without the buttons that depend on the caret and are hidden, together with the variants and the two list entries, grouped under category headings with an icon and a shortcut while the query is empty, and a disabled No command row when the query matches nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-240 — The slash query ranks matches and leaves loose matches to the text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-240.md) — When the writer types a query after the slash, the extension SHALL narrow the list at each edit to the commands whose label or alias matches it, ignoring case, ranked exact first, then prefix, word start, contained text and a tight subsequence of three or more letters that starts at a word start (the command of the MyST group first in MyST mode), light the first entry, and leave Enter and Tab to the text when the best match is only a loose one and the highlight was not moved.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-242 — Keys and clicks drive the slash menu and run the lit command](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-242.md) — When the slash menu is open, the extension SHALL take ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, a click and a hover for the menu, running the lit command in one edit and leaving every other key and the text to the text box.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-252 — The slash menu is an announced listbox of text-only rows](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-252.md) — While the slash menu is open, the extension SHALL expose it as a listbox named Commands with option rows, announce the number of commands in a polite live region, set every entry as text, and keep the lit command readable when the system forces colours.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-256 — The slash menu stays next to the caret inside the viewport](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-256.md) — When the slash menu opens, the extension SHALL place it under the caret line inside the viewport, uncovered by the floating toolbar, with a maximum height of 320 px and an edge of 8 px, above the caret when there is no room below, and keep it next to the caret while the writer types, scrolls or resizes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-263 — Slash commands have short alternative names](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-263.md) — When the writer types an alternative name after the slash, the extension SHALL list the command that carries that alias among the commands of the current palette mode, as it lists it for its label.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-264 — A pasted URL becomes a link, an autolink or an image in the block text box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-264.md) — When the writer pastes into the block text box a clipboard whose plain text is a single http, https or mailto address and that holds no text/html, and the paste is not a paste as plain text, the extension SHALL replace the selection of the paste with \[selected text\](url) when text is selected, with <url> when nothing is selected, and with !\[alt\](url) for an http or https address whose path ends in .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .svg or .webp, in one undo step, leaving the rest of the source unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-265 — The Full palette mode adds Vega-Lite and Vega chart commands](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-265.md) — When the palette mode is Full, the extension SHALL list the Vega-Lite chart and Vega chart actions in the edition palette and the slash menu (/chart and /vega), each inserting a fenced starter chart after the selection, and no other mode SHALL list them.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
